backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the quiz/motivation app with functions to add questions, evaluate answers, add/retrieve motivations, and list all content, with data migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that seeds the puzzles map with 25 pre-defined JEE-style physics, chemistry, and mathematics multiple-choice questions during actor upgrade.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the EduTech Nova SPA, mounting the React app at the root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, quiz, quiz results, and motivation pages, all wrapped in a shared Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Shared page layout with a sticky header containing logo and nav links, a main content area, and a footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity authentication hook and provider that manages AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and exposes identity state and status flags via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useMotivation.ts: Custom hook that fetches random motivation messages from the backend, retrying up to three times to avoid consecutive duplicate messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating questions and motivations via the backend actor, including get-all, add, and random-fetch operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuiz.ts: Implements a stateful quiz hook managing current question index, answer selection, scoring, and navigation through questions until the quiz is finished.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind, and defines light/dark CSS custom properties (OKLCH color tokens) plus utility classes for gradients and answer options.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section with CTA buttons to navigate to the Quiz and Motivation pages, plus a features grid highlighting both tools.
frontend/src/pages/Motivation.tsx: Motivation page that auto-fetches and displays a random motivational quote on mount, with a button to fetch a new one and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/Quiz.tsx: Quiz page that loads questions, renders the current question with answer options, tracks progress and score, and navigates to the results page when finished.
frontend/src/pages/QuizResults.tsx: Displays the quiz results page showing score percentage via an SVG circle chart, a grade label, and stat cards for total/correct/incorrect answers. Provides buttons to retry the quiz or return home, reading score and total from URL search params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Space Grotesk, Nunito), oklch-based color tokens (amber, teal, semantic UI colors), custom border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations. Enables dark mode via class and includes typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state (version 7) for EduTech Nova, an educational React/TypeScript app converted from Kivy, listing implemented features (home, quiz, motivation, results screens with theming) and pending feature requests (new motivational quotes and 25 JEE-style quiz questions).
